warnings: This is a rice study, not wheat - may not be relevant to wheat Zn meta-analysis
Uses agar nutrient solution (ANS) system, not traditional soil/foliar fertilizer application
Zn treatments are solution concentrations (0.005μM vs 1.5μM), not fertilizer applications
Multiple experiments with different genotype sets - need careful separation
Some genotypes failed to mature in certain experiments (e.g., Jalmagna, KP)
Brown rice Zn concentration is the grain outcome, not total grain including hull
Mass balance calculations in Table 7 are derived data, not direct measurements

recon.sample_size_source: Zn was supplied in two concentrations, 0.005μM (Zn-deficient) and 1.5μM ZnSO4·7H2O (Zn-sufficient), with five replications each
recon.extraction_guidance: This paper studies rice in hydroponic solution culture, not wheat with fertilizer application. The Zn treatments are nutrient solution concentrations rather than fertilizer applications. Only Table 4 contains grain Zn concentration data (brown rice Zn concentration). This study may not be appropriate for inclusion in a wheat fertilizer meta-analysis due to different species and application method.
